CANTON, CHINA SATURDAY, FEBRUARY 26, 1927
INTERNATIONAL WORKERS DELEGATION
ARE GUESTS OF HONOUR OF CANTON
TRADES UNION ORGANIZATIONS

The visit of the International Workers Delegation to the Canton trade union organizations is of special significance. The members of the I.W.D. are representatives of the revolutionary labor organizations of their respective countries. All of them are workers: Tom Mann, England, is a metal worker and is the honorary president of the National Minority Movement of Great Britain, and organization which comprises the best revolutionary elements in the British labor movement. Earl Browder, the American representative was a building laborer before he became a professional labor journalist, and is one of the Executive Committee of the Trade Union Educational League of America. Jaques Doriot is a metal worker, and is known as the thorn in the eye of French militarism and imperialism. The visit of revolutionary workers and trade unionists coming directly from the three great Western imperialist countries —England, France, and America— to the labor and trade union organizations of revolutionary Canton is a symbol of the militant alliance of the revolutionary working class of the whole world with the working classes and oppressed peoples of the East and of revolutionary China.

Visit Strike Committee
In the forenoon of February 22, the delegation visited the Hongkong Strike Committee. This visit was, as expressed by the 71-year old British delegate, Tom Mann, a real treat to the eyes, hearts and minds of the International Workers Delegation. The Hongkong Strike and the Strike Committee are well-known to the workers of all countries and the heroic struggle and gigantic historic role played by them in the struggle against imperialism in China are admired and revered by millions of workers in the imperialist and capitalist countries of the West. Hongkong has become a mighty revolutionary symbol to the militant working class everywhere. Such were the thoughts expressed by the International Workers Delegates.

At Review
The delegation were present at a review of the Hongkong strike pickets and of the Canton Workers Defense Corps, who went through their drills and manoeuvres to the visible admiration of the visiting delegates. But the hearts of the delegates were completely won by the impressive procession and drilling of more than a thousands of uniformed children, the Pioneers, in age ranging from 5 to 15 years. A deep impression was made on the delegation by the speech of Fong Kong, a 10 year old Pioneer, who greeted the Delegation with an eloquent address. Tom Mann was moved to tears by the sight of this young representative of revolutionary China addressing the mass meeting and for world unity of all exploited classes and peoples in the great struggle against tyranny and oppression. The American delegate, Browder, recognized in one of the songs of the children, the tune of an old church hymn imported into China by the missionaries, and upon inquiry found that the new text being sung by the children was in memory of the great revolutionary Leader, Lenin.

Ovation For Roy
Later the delegation attended a special meeting of the Strike Delegates, some 600 in number, who have conducted the Hongkong Strike for over a year and a half. The meeting elected one of the delegates to give the welcome address to the visitors. Great enthusiasm was shown, especially when Tom Mann, after a stirring speech, gave the slogans of the meeting in the Chinese language. M.N.Roy greeted the strike leaders in the name of the Communist International, pointing out the leading role played by the Hong Kong and Shanghai working class in every critical moment of the Chinese Revolution, and amidst an ovation by the delegates, he pledged the Communist International to continue to mobilize the workers of the world to ally themselves with the Chinese people in the common struggle against the scourge of imperialism.

Mechanics Union
Two of the visiting delegation being themselves metal workers (Engineers), the visit made to the Mechanics' (Engineers) Union was of particular interest to them. The Delegation were received most cordially by the chairman of the All China Mechanics' Union, Mr. Wong Kwon-lang, and by the chairman of the Canton Mechanics' Union, Mr. Wong Keng-shi. The keenest interest of the delegation was aroused by the Hongkong striking members who are now living with their families in the big building which houses the Mechanics Union at Honam; by the union printing shop which prints three union journals, by the Union school, and other features of the Union headquarters. The history of the
(Continued on Page 2)
Mechanics Union, and its struggles, which date back to 1905, was noted by the delegates with great interest.

Labor and Peasant Banquet
In the evening of February 22, the delegates were present at a reception and banquet given by the labor and peasant organizations of Canton. The reception was organized by a joint Committee consisting of delegates from
1. The Peasants' League of Kwangtung.
2. All-China Labor Federation.
3. Canton General Labor Union.
4. Canton Mechanics' Union.
5. Canton Trade Union Council.
6. Hongkong Federation of Trade Union.
7. Canton-Hongkong Strike Committee.
8. Seamen's Union of China.
A brotherly and intimate atmosphere reigned at this banquet. It was like a healthy, robust, convincing handshake of the working class of the West with the workers of the East. Workers' leaders recalled in their addresses some great battles of the working class in various countries; the battles won and lost; battles that taught and encouraged the toiling masses to organize better and to fight on until the final victory is achieved.

中国广州，1927年2月26日，星期六
国际工人代表团
是广州工会组织的荣誉嘉宾

国际工人代表团访问广州工会组织具有特殊意义。国际工人代表团（I.W.D.）成员是其各自国家革命劳工组织的代表。他们全都是工人：汤姆·曼（Tom Mann），英国人，是一名金属工人，也是大不列颠全国少数派运动（National Minority Movement）的名誉主席，该组织汇集了英国劳工运动中最好的革命分子。美国代表厄尔·白劳德（Earl Browder）在成为职业劳工记者之前是一名建筑工人，他是美国工会教育联盟执行委员会成员之一。雅克·多里奥（Jaques Doriot）是一名金属工人，被视为法国军国主义和帝国主义的眼中钉。来自三大西方帝国主义国家——英国、法国和美国——的革命工人和工会主义者访问革命广州的劳工和工会组织，象征着全世界革命工人阶级与东方及革命中国的工人阶级和被压迫人民的战斗联盟。

访问罢工委员会

2月22日上午，代表团访问了香港罢工委员会。正如71岁的英国代表汤姆·曼所言，这次访问对国际工人代表团来说，真正是一场悦目、赏心、益智的盛宴。香港罢工和罢工委员会为各国工人所熟知，他们在反对中国帝国主义的斗争中所发挥的英雄壮举和巨大的历史作用，受到西方帝国主义和资本主义国家数百万工人的钦佩和敬仰。香港已成为各地战斗工人阶级的强大革命象征。国际工人代表们表达了这样的想法。

检阅现场

代表团出席了香港罢工纠察队和广州工人自卫队的检阅仪式，他们的操练和演习赢得了来访代表们显而易见的赞赏。但是，完全赢得代表们欢心的，是超过一千名身着制服的儿童——先锋队（Pioneers）——令人印象深刻的队列行进和操练，他们的年龄从5岁到15岁不等。一名10岁的先锋队员方刚（Fong Kong，音译）用一篇雄辩的致辞欢迎代表团，给代表团留下了深刻印象。看到这位革命中国的年轻代表在群众集会上发表演讲，呼吁所有被剥削阶级和人民在反对暴政和压迫的伟大斗争中实现世界团结，汤姆·曼感动得流下了眼泪。美国代表白劳德在孩子们的一首歌曲中辨认出由传教士传入中国的一首古老教堂赞美诗的曲调，经询问得知，孩子们演唱的新歌词是为了纪念伟大的革命领袖列宁。

向罗伊欢呼

随后，代表团参加了一次罢工代表特别会议，与会者约600人，他们领导香港罢工已有一年半之久。会议选举了一名代表向访客致欢迎辞。现场表现出极大的热情，特别是当汤姆·曼在发表了一篇激动人心的演讲后，用中文喊出了会议的口号时。M.N.罗伊（M.N.Roy）以共产国际的名义向罢工领导人致意，指出香港和上海工人阶级在中国革命的每一个关键时刻都发挥了领导作用；在代表们的热烈欢呼声中，他承诺共产国际将继续动员世界工人，与中国民众结盟，共同反对帝国主义这一祸害。

机械工会

由于来访代表团中有两名成员本身就是金属工人（工程师），他们对机械（工程师）工会的访问特别感兴趣。中华全国机械工会主席黄权朗（Wong Kwon-lang，音译）先生和广州机械工会主席黄敬仕（Wong Keng-shi，音译）先生最热情地接待了代表团。目前与家人居住在河南机械工会大楼内的香港罢工会员、印刷三份工会刊物的工会印刷所、工会学校以及工会总部的其他特色设施，引起了代表团最浓厚的兴趣。机械工会的历史及其始于1905年的斗争历程，引起了代表们的极大关注。
（续至第2页）

工农宴会

2月22日晚，代表们出席了由广州劳工和农民组织举办的招待会及宴会。招待会由一个联合委员会组织，成员包括以下机构的代表：
1. 广东省农民协会。
2. 中华全国总工会。
3. 广州总工会。
4. 广州机械工会。
5. 广州工会理事会。
6. 香港工会联合会。
7. 省港罢工委员会。
8. 中国海员工会。

宴会上洋溢着兄弟般亲密的气氛。这就像西方工人阶级与东方工人之间一次健康、有力且令人信服的握手。工运领袖们在致辞中回顾了各国工人阶级的一些重大战役；那些赢得的和失利的战役；那些教导并鼓励劳动大众更好地组织起来、战斗下去直至取得最终胜利的战役。

INTERNATIONAL WORKERS DELEGATION
ARE GUESTS OF HONOUR OF CANTON
TRADES UNION ORGANIZATIONS

(Continued from Page 1)

by big conflict mentioned by the speakers had a definite, indelible name which stamped its place in working-class history: The British Miners' Strike, and the General Strike; the Hongkong Strike; the Shanghai General Strike; the Passaic Textile Strike in America; the 24-hour General Strike in France against the Moroccan War. etc. A tense moment occurred when Sou Chou-ging, chairman of the All-China Labor Federation, announced the news just arrived from Shanghai of the execution of dozens of trade union leaders there by the tool of British Imperialism, Sun Chuan-fang. The indignation of the gathering was indescribable. The speeches that followed were all permeated with a seething spirit of battle, a challenge and a warning to the murderers and instigators of murder of Chinese workers.

Cable Appeals

The International Workers Delegation informed the leaders of the labor and peasant organizations that two telegraphic appeals had been sent out by the Delegation to the workers of the world to mobilize all forces against foreign intervention in China. One of the telegrams was despatched to the All-India Trade Union Congress and Indian National Congress, calling upon them to prevent the sending of Indian troops to China and the recall of those already sent. The other was despatched to the revolutionary labor organizations represented by the delegation, to mobilize all forces against the imminent armed intervention of Gt. Britain.. (Note: The text of these two telegrams appeared in the CANTON GAZETTE of February 25)

Of the speeches made by Chinese representatives at the gathering, the following are a few notes. The representative of the Kwangtung Peasant League delivered a fiery speech in which he pointed out the gigantic role of the peasants in the national liberation movement. He finished by saying that the revolutionary peasants will drive the imperialists and oppressors out of China if necessary with their axes and picks. The speaker for the Hongkong strikers made a brilliant speech, in which he compared British imperialism with a lion that has false teeth and false claws---these teeth and claws being the purchased Chinese militarists. This lion is now raging mad in Shanghai and must be driven out or killed. This lion is not only having its false teeth and claws torn out by the Chinese revolution, but it is also being torn to pieces in its own entrails---witness the miners' strike and the General Strike. The Hongkong workers had to live inside the monster, but the Hongkong Strike has given the beast a big stomach-ache and is still gnawing away, while the revolutionary workers of Britain attack the heart and liver of the monster which is doomed to a violent and dishonorable death.

The banquet closed, with Tom Mann singing the Kuomintang song in the Chinese language, and with the singing of the Internationale.

International Workers Delegates Address Chinese Masses

Canton has seen many great mass meetings and demonstrations, but the one held on February 23, on the Sun Yat-sen University Campus was unique in its nature and opened a new page in the history of the Chinese liberation movement. At this demonstration over 10,000 workers, peasants, students, women, soldiers, and merchants delegated by their respective organizations came to greet and hear the message of the International Workers Delegation. The sentiments of the Canton organizations which participated in this mass meeting, and of the Canton masses, are best expressed in the short slogan written on the banner presented to the Delegation by the mass meeting. The inscription reads:

"To the International Workers Delegation, to the leaders and general staff of the world's working class. The Alliance of the world proletariat with the oppressed peoples will free the world from the curse of imperialism and reaction, and will create a new and free world on the ruins of the old."

This inscription shows that the Canton masses and their leaders have grasped the deep significance of the visit of the International Workers Delegation to China. This inscription was the keynote of the great mass meeting and of all the addresses delivered by the Chinese and international speakers.

Each of the international delegates, as well as the representative of the Communist International, spoke on each of the three platforms erected on the University campus. At one of the platforms were assembled the delegations of workers' and peasants' organizations; at another were the delegations of the revolutionary army and police (including an impressive delegation from the Whampoa Central Military-Political Academy); the third platform was that of the students, women's and merchants organizations.

Tom Mann Speaks

The enthusiasm of the masses grew ever more visible and expressive as each of the international delegates made the round of all these platforms. A conspicuous and popular figure on each was Tom Mann, representative of the revolutionary workers of Great Britain. He led the cheers and shouted the slogans in chorus with the masses he addressed.

"I am a British worker", Tom Mann said, "coming from the country whose government has robbed you, has bled you, that has perpetrated so many crimes against your great people. I came here to encourage you to destroy the British imperialism and to drive the imperialists out of China. Together with us, the revolutionary workers of England and the proletariat of the world, we will wipe British and world imperialism off the face of the earth. I came here to assure you that there are millions of workers in Great Britain who think and feel as I do. We will triumph over our common enemy." 为广州工会组织之贵宾

（续第1页）

演讲者所提及的重大冲突均有明确且不可磨灭的名称，在工人阶级历史上留下了深刻印记：英国矿工罢工及总罢工；香港罢工；上海总罢工；美国帕塞伊克（Passaic）纺织工人大罢工；法国反对摩洛哥战争的24小时总罢工等。当中华全国总工会主席苏兆征宣布刚从上海传来的消息——数十名工会领袖被英帝国主义的走狗孙传芳处决时，现场气氛一度十分紧张。与会者的愤慨之情难以言表。随后的演讲无不洋溢着激烈的战斗精神，向杀害中国工人的凶手及幕后指使者发出挑战与警告。

电报呼吁

国际工人代表团告知劳工和农民组织的领导人，代表团已向全世界工人发出两份电报呼吁，动员一切力量反对列强干涉中国。其中一份电报发往全印工会大会和印度国民大会，呼吁他们阻止派遣印度军队前往中国，并召回已派遣的部队。另一份电报发往由代表团代表的各革命劳工组织，动员一切力量反对英国迫在眉睫的武装干涉。（注：这两份电报的全文刊登于2月25日的《广州日报》）

关于中国代表在集会上的发言，谨录数则如下。广东省农民协会代表发表了激昂的演讲，指出农民在民族解放运动中的巨大作用。他在结束时表示，如有必要，革命农民将用斧头和锄头将帝国主义者和压迫者赶出中国。香港罢工工人代表发表了精彩演讲，将英帝国主义比作一头拥有假牙和假爪的狮子——这些牙齿和爪子即是被收买的中国军阀。这头狮子如今在上海疯狂肆虐，必须将其驱逐或杀死。中国革命不仅正在拔掉这头狮子的假牙和假爪，更使其内脏撕裂——矿工罢工和总罢工即为明证。香港工人不得不生活在这头怪兽体内，但香港罢工已使这头野兽遭受剧烈的腹痛，并仍在不断啃噬其肌体，而英国的革命工人则攻击这头注定要暴毙且身败名裂的怪兽的心肝。

宴会结束时，汤姆·曼（Tom Mann）用中文演唱了国民党党歌，随后众人齐唱《国际歌》。

国际工人代表团向中国民众发表演说

广州曾举行过许多大型群众集会和示威活动，但2月23日在中山大学校园举行的这次集会性质独特，在中国解放运动史上翻开了新的一页。在这次示威活动中，一万多名由各自组织派出的工人、农民、学生、妇女、士兵和商人前来欢迎并聆听国际工人代表团的信息。参加此次集会的广州各组织以及广州民众的情感，最好地体现在集会献给代表团的横幅上所写的简短口号中。题词写道：

“致国际工人代表团，致世界工人阶级的领袖和总参谋部。世界无产阶级与被压迫民族的联盟将从帝国主义和反动的诅咒中解放世界，并在旧世界的废墟上创造一个崭新的自由世界。”

这段题词表明，广州民众及其领导者已深刻认识到国际工人代表团访华的深远意义。这段题词是此次大型集会以及中外演讲者所有致辞的主旨。

每一位国际代表以及共产国际的代表都在大学校园内搭建的三个讲台上分别发表了讲话。其中一个讲台聚集了工农组织的代表团；另一个讲台是革命军队和警察的代表团（其中包括来自黄埔中央军事政治学校的一个令人印象深刻的代表团）；第三个讲台则是学生、妇女和商人组织的讲台。

汤姆·曼发表演讲

随着每一位国际代表轮流在各个讲台发表讲话，群众的热情愈发高涨且表现得淋漓尽致。在每个讲台上，英国革命工人代表汤姆·曼都是一个引人注目且广受欢迎的人物。他带领欢呼，并与他所面对的群众一起高呼口号。

“我是一名英国工人，”汤姆·曼说，“我来自那个掠夺你们、榨取你们鲜血、对你们伟大的人民犯下无数罪行的政府所在的国家。我来这里是为了鼓励你们摧毁英帝国主义，将帝国主义者赶出中国。我们将与英国革命工人及世界无产阶级一道，将英国和世界帝国主义从地球表面彻底清除。我来这里是为了向你们保证，英国有数百万工人与我有着相同的思想和感受。我们将战胜我们共同的敌人。”群众对这些话语的反应如雷鸣般热烈，席卷了

印度的捍卫者

共产国际代表M. N. Roy一登上讲台便受到了热烈欢迎。作为一名印度人，他是受压迫的印度人民的捍卫者，也是唯一一个以解放被压迫民族作为世界革命组成部分为口号、在各地吸纳了数百万工农的世界组织的代表。Roy生动地象征了被压迫民族与世界工人阶级联盟原则的真理及其实现。由印度人Roy代表世界工人阶级组织发言，使这一联盟变得有血有肉。中国民众理解这一点，这正是Roy受到热烈欢迎的原因所在。

Roy表示，来自帝国主义国家的革命工人，以及他本人作为共产国际的代表，来到中国是为了向帝国主义的一切势力发起挑战。革命中国与革命俄罗斯以及帝国主义国家革命工人阶级的联盟，构成了一股不可战胜的力量，帝国主义者和所有自由的敌人都将在这股力量面前碰得头破血流。

其他国际代表，来自法国的多里奥（Doriot）和来自美国的白劳德（Browder），以其充满活力的鼓舞性言辞和战斗性的演讲激发了听众的热情。这是一次令人难忘的会议。这是革命东方与革命西方的汇合。它标志着中国人民与世界无产阶级战斗团结纽带的巩固。

THE CANTON GAZETTE, FEB. 25, 1927.

PROTESTS AGAINST BRITISH TROOPS
IN SHANGHAI ARE CABLED ABROAD BY
INTERNATIONAL WORKERS DELEGATION

In view of the fact that the British imperialists have resorted to the use of thousands of Indian troops in China, the International Worker's Delegation in China have despatched the following telegram to the Indian National Congress, the Indian Trade Union Congress and to the "Forward," the central nationalist organ of India:

First Telegram

1. Indian National Congress.
2. Indian Trade Union Congress.
3. The Forward, Central Nationalist Organ.

British imperialism wants to crush the Chinese national revolutionary forces by open military intervention. For this purpose it is planning to make use of Indian troops who are being sent to China in large number. The Chinese people are fighting the battles of all the oppressed nations. The proletariat of the imperialist countries are determined to oppose the policy of intervention in China. It is the duty of the nationalist and labour movement of India to rush to the help of the Chinese revolution. Take energetic action to prevent dispatch of Indian troops to China. Demand immediate withdrawal of those already in China. Issue appeals to the troops to fraternise with the Chinese people instead of fighting them.

International Workers Delegation to China, Tom Mann, England, Jacques Doriot, France, Earl Browder, America.
Representative of the Communist International in China, M. N. Roy.

Second Telegram

The possibility of armed imperialist intervention in Shanghai, and of a clash between the nationalist revolutionary army and foreign military forces, becoming imminent, the International Workers' Delegation to China have despatched the following telegram to the respective revolutionary labour organisations represented by the international delegates.

1. National Minority movement, London.
2. Unitary Trade Union Federation of France, Paris.
3. Trade Union Education League of America, Chicago, U.S.A.

Thousands of British troops have been landed in Shanghai. More military and naval forces are concentrated nearby to be rushed on the scene at short notice. Italy has openly endorsed the British policy of coercion and open military intervention. France while taking a non-committal attitude is secretly in agreement with the policy of intervention and follows the line to realize her own ambition and gives arms and munitions to the reactionary militarists of Yunnan. American scheme to neutralize Shanghai is a manoeuvre to gain for American imperialism a more privileged position but means annexation of the greatest Chinese port and industrial centre by international imperialism. If this scheme is adopted the imperialists will arrogate to themselves the right to fight the national revolutionary army with military forces when it will advance upon Shanghai. The forces of native militarism in the maritime provinces which were amply supported by international imperialism have been defeated by the national revolutionary army which is closing upon Shanghai. A direct clash between the nationalist revolutionary army and foreign military forces on the possession of Shanghai is thus imminent. At the same time the imperialist powers are helping the native reactionary and militarist elements in their respective spheres of influence with arms, munitions and money. The proletariat of the imperialist countries must oppose this attempt to crush the national liberation movement in China. Organize a systematic campaign of protest against direct or indirect intervention in China. Ask the Amsterdam International and Unions affiliated to it to make united front on this very urgent question and set up "Hands off China" Committees and issue joint appeals to the naval and military forces to revolt if they are sent to fight the Chinese people.
(Sd.) International Workers Delegation to China,
Tom Mann, England;
Jacques Doriot, France;
Earl Browder, America.
Representative of the Communist International in China: M.N. Roy.

国际工人代表团向海外发电报
抗议英军驻沪

鉴于英国帝国主义者在中国动用数千名印度部队的事实，在华国际工人代表团已向印度国民大会、印度工会大会以及印度民族主义中央机关报《前进报》发出如下电报：

第一封电报

1. 印度国民大会。
2. 印度工会大会。
3. 《前进报》，民族主义中央机关报。

英国帝国主义企图通过公开的军事干涉来扼杀中国民族革命力量。为此，它正计划利用正被大量派往中国的印度军队。中国人民正在为所有被压迫民族而战。帝国主义国家的无产阶级决心反对干涉中国的政策。印度的民族主义运动和劳工运动有责任迅速援助中国革命。采取有力行动，阻止派遣印度军队前往中国。要求立即撤走已在中国的军队。呼吁士兵们与中国人民亲善，而不是与他们作战。

赴华国际工人代表团，汤姆·曼（Tom Mann），英国；雅克·多里奥（Jacques Doriot），法国；厄尔·白劳德（Earl Browder），美国。
共产国际驻华代表，M. N. 罗伊（M. N. Roy）。

第二封电报

鉴于帝国主义武装干涉上海的可能性，以及民族革命军与外国军队之间发生冲突的可能性日益迫近，赴华国际工人代表团已向由国际代表所代表的各革命劳工组织发出如下电报。

1. 全国少数族裔运动（National Minority movement），伦敦。

MANIFESTO OF INTERNATIONAL WORKERS DELEGATION

In connection with the mass demonstration which is taking place
today, Feb. 25, to voice the protest of the Chinese people and the
revolutionary workers of the world against imperialism and foreign
intervention, the following manifesto has been issued to the people
of Canton by the International Workers Delegation:
TO THE PEOPLE OF CANTON

"Having come to your city to greet you and to greet your govern-
ment and your organizations, we take advantage of this opportunity to
call upon you and your organizations to participate in the international
demonstration against foreign intervention in your country- on Feb. 25th
1927.

At this particular moment it is British imperialism that is the
most aggressive in the oppression of your people. Foreign troops in
large numbers are being landed in China for the purpose of halting
the victorious advance of the nationalist armies, in order to combat
your Revolution and to support the reactionary Chinese militarists.
We protest most energetically against this intervention and we demand
the withdrawal of all foreign troops from China, just as the organizations
we represent have repeatedly demanded such withdrawal of all foreign
imperialist forces.

But the crimes of British imperialism should not and cannot make
us forget the bestialities and crimes perpetrated by the other
imperialist powers.

French imperialism has always carried on a distinct policy of
oppression in China. It was first to work hand in hand with British
imperialism imposing upon China the unequal treaties. The French
imperialists helped massacre your brothers in Shanghai. They also
supply the reactionary militarists of Yunnan with arms and munitions.
American imperialism is the most insidious and hypocritical. It poses
as the friend of the Chinese people. But in reality American imperialism
is only taking advantage of your liberation struggle to oust its British
and Japanese competitors from the Pacific and to get a stronger strang-
lehold on your country. It is the most dangerous enemy of the Chinese
people.

The Chinese people can expect from the imperialists nothing but
oppression and enslavement. The only true friend and ally of the
Chinese people are the revolutionary workers of all countries.

The revolutionary proletariat of the world is for the complete
abolition of the shameful privileges of the imperialists in your
country. It is for the complete abolition of the unequal treaties.
It is for the complete and final victory of your revolution, and for
the absolute defeat of all imperialisms and reactionary militarists.

In the name of the revolutionary proletariat of the world, the Inter-
national Workers Delegation cries out with you:

Down with imperialism ! Let the foreign soldiers and sailors in
China fraternise with Chinese people ! Down with the reactionary
militarists ! Long live the National Army ! Long live the Chinese
people ! Long live the national revolution ! Long live the world
revolution ! The International Workers Delegation:
TOM MANN, England;
BROWDER, America;
DORIOT, France.

国际工人代表团宣言

鉴于今天，2月25日，正在举行大规模示威，以表达中国人民和世界革命工人对帝国主义及外国干涉的抗议，国际工人代表团特向广州民众发布如下宣言：

致广州民众

“我们要来到贵市，向你们、你们的政府及你们的组织致意，我们借此机会呼吁你们及你们的组织参加于1927年2月25日举行的反对干涉贵国的国际示威。

在此特定时刻，英国帝国主义在压迫贵国人民方面最为猖獗。大量外国军队正在中国登陆，目的是阻止民族军队的胜利进军，以对抗你们的革命，并支持中国反动军阀。我们对此种干涉表示最强烈的抗议，并要求所有外国军队撤出中国，正如我们所代表的组织一再要求撤走所有外国帝国主义军队一样。

但是，英国帝国主义的罪行不应也不能让我们忘记其他帝国主义列强所犯下的兽行和罪行。

法国帝国主义在中国一直推行明确的压迫政策。它率先与英国帝国主义勾结，强迫中国签订不平等条约。法国帝国主义者协助在上海屠杀你们的兄弟。他们还向云南的反动军阀提供武器和弹药。美国帝国主义最为阴险和虚伪。它伪装成中国人民的朋友。但实际上，美国帝国主义只是利用你们的解放斗争，将其英国和日本竞争对手逐出太平洋，并加强对贵国的控制。它是中国人民最危险的敌人。

中国人民从帝国主义者那里只能期待压迫和奴役。中国人民唯一真正的朋友和盟友是各国的革命工人。

世界革命无产阶级主张彻底废除帝国主义在贵国的可耻特权。主张彻底废除不平等条约。主张你们的革命取得完全和最终的胜利，主张彻底击败所有帝国主义和反动军阀。

国际工人代表团代表世界革命无产阶级，与你们一同高呼：

打倒帝国主义！让在中国的外国士兵和水兵与中国人民亲善！打倒反动军阀！国民革命军万岁！中国人民万岁！民族革命万岁！世界革命万岁！国际工人代表团：
汤姆·曼，英国；
白劳德，美国；
多里奥，法国。

INTERNATIONAL WORKERS DELEGATION
PAY VISIT TO CENTRAL MILITARY AND
POLITICAL ACADEMY AT WHAMPOA

On February 21st the International Workers Delegation to China and the representative of the Communist International visited the Central Military and Political Academy at Whampoa. The Delegation was present at the weekly memorial meeting dedicated to the memory of Sun Yat-sen. In the name of the International Workers Delegation, Tom Mann, the representative of the British revolutionary workers, paid tribute to the memory of Sun Yat-sen. He expressed the hope that the great revolutionary leader's doctrines and teachings will be followed faithfully by the National Revolutionary Army and by the National People's Government. He assured them of the solidarity of millions of workers in all countries in the common struggle against imperialism.

The Struggle Against Imperialism

At a special meeting called by the Central Military and Political Academy of Whampoa, were present the entire student and teaching body of the Academy. All members of the International Workers Delegation and the representative of the Communist International addressed this historical meeting. The representative from Great Britain, Tom Mann, in his address recalled the endless list of atrocities perpetrated by British imperialism in China and the many bloody pages written into history by the British colonial oppressors. The Chinese heroic fight for liberation is only another front of the international struggle against a common enemy.—Imperialism. The peoples of India and Egypt and the other colonies on the one hand, and the British proletariat on the other, and the allies of the Chinese people. Every defeat of British imperialism in China is a victory for the British working class and for the oppressed colonial peoples. Every victory of the national revolutionary army in China brings joy and encouragement to the hearts of tens and hundreds of millions of exploited people in London, Manchester, Bombay, Calcutta, Cairo. While the British army and navy are still used to break strikes at home and to suppress revolutionary movements abroad, the Chinese revolutionary army is defending the cause of the Chinese people whose support they have.

International Fraternity

Doriot, the representative of the revolutionary working class of France, flayed the activities of French imperialism in the French colonies and in China. The revolutionary proletariat of France understand the significance of revolutionary armies of China and Russia. They will fight for the defeat of the French army and navy which are tools of reaction and oppression and for the victory of the Chinese revolutionary army which is the instrument of progress and liberation. 反对帝国主义的斗争

在黄埔中央军事政治学校召开的特别会议上，该校全体师生出席。国际工人代表团全体成员和共产国际代表均在这次具有历史意义的会议上发表了讲话。英国代表汤姆·曼在讲话中回顾了英国帝国主义在中国犯下的无数暴行，以及英国殖民压迫者在历史上写下的许多血腥篇章。中国人民英勇的解放斗争只是国际反对共同敌人——帝国主义——斗争的另一条战线。一方面，印度、埃及和其他殖民地的人民，另一方面，英国无产阶级，都是中国人民的盟友。英国帝国主义在中国的每一次失败，都是英国工人阶级和被压迫殖民地人民的胜利。中国民族革命军的每一次胜利，都给伦敦、曼彻斯特、孟买、加尔各答、开罗等地数以亿计的受剥削人民的心中带来喜悦和鼓励。当英国海陆军仍被用于破坏国内罢工和镇压国外革命运动时，中国革命军正在捍卫其所支持的中国人民的事业。

在俄国，被派去帮助反革命势力的法国士兵和水手实现了 fraternization（联欢/亲善）。法国帝国主义在中国也将失败，因为法国水手和士兵一旦认识到中国革命的意义，就会将刺刀和大炮对准他们的帝国主义误导者。国际工人代表团将向中国的外国士兵和水手发出呼吁，要求他们与国民革命军实现 fraternization（联欢/亲善）。俄国的同样经验表明，这并非乌托邦。代表团来到这里，是为了向中国人民保证国际工人阶级的团结。革命事业的胜利是有保障的。

E. 鲍德纳（E. Browder）代表美国革命工人发言，警告人们提防美国的虚假友谊。在友谊的面具背后是一个危险的敌人。美帝国主义谨慎但残忍。美国对中美洲和南美洲的武装干涉撕下了其虚假友谊的面具。

THE CANTON GAZETTE, MONDAY, FEBRUARY 21, 1927

WARM WELCOME TO INTERNATIONAL
WORKERS DELEGATION; OBJECT OF VISIT
TOLD TO GATHERING OF ALL CLASSES

The International Workers Delegation to China, consisting of well-known representatives of the revolutionary labour movement in the three great imperialist countries,—England, France and the United States,—arrived at Canton on February 18th. The revolutionary labour movement of these countries are represented by Tom Mann, the honorary president of the National Minority Movement of Great Britain, Jaques Doriot, Communist Deputy in the French Chamber and known for his ruthless fight against French imperialism in Morocco, Syria and China, and Earl Browder,—Executive member of the Trade Union Educational League of America, which organization has been carrying on energetic propaganda jointly with the Kuomintang organizations in the United States and Canada against imperialism and for the cause of Chinese liberation.

Object of Visit

The object and purpose of the International Workers Delegation is the following:
1. To bring greetings and the expression of sympathy and solidarity to the National Revolutionary Government of China and the Kuomintang from the international proletariat.
2. To study the situation in China and to acquaint themselves intimately with the problems, aims, aspirations and obstacles to be overcome in the great struggle of the Chinese people against world imperialism.
3. To establish contact and a lasting militant alliance between the revolutionary labour movement of the world and the Chinese revolutionary liberation movement.
4. To encourage the Chinese people in their heroic struggle and to do everything possible to render moral and material aid to the Chinese revolutionary cause.
5. To utilize all the knowledge and information gathered by the Delegation in China for the purpose of mobilising the international labour movement to come to the aid of revolutionary China by preventing the imperialist powers from carrying out their predatory plans.

Call On Govt. And Party

The first visits of the International Workers Delegation on Feb. 19th were paid to the Kwangtung Provincial Government and the Kuomintang Party Committee. The Delegation were received very cordially by Mr. Chen Shu-jen, Commissioner of Civil affairs. The Delegation transmitted to Mr. Chen Shu-jen a telegram of greetings addressed by the Delegates to Marshal Chiang Kai-shih the head of the National Revolutionary Army.

In the afternoon of the same day the International Workers Delegation visited the Trade Union headquarters and the following labour organizations: the All-China Labour Federation, the Hong-Kong Strike Committee, the Canton Workers Assembly and the Hong Kong General Federation. A joint meeting of the representatives of these organizations with the Delegation took place at the headquarters and all the members of the International Workers Delegation addressed the meeting. The Chinese Labour representatives received the delegation most warmly and responded with great enthusiasm when the objects and aims of the Delegation were explained to them. Sou Sau-ching, the Chairman of the All-China Labour Federation greeted the delegation in the name of the 1,200,000 members of his organization. (A figure that is constantly increasing with the advance of the National Revolutionary Army.) He said that the visit and work of the International Workers Delegation will give new energy and courage to the Chinese masses in their struggle against imperialism and militarism. He called for World unity of the international proletariat and an alliance with the oppressed peoples of the world. With such a mighty alliance, he said, victory is ours. Nothing can stop us.

热烈欢迎国际工人代表团；向各界集会阐明访问目的

由英、法、美三个主要帝国主义国家革命劳工运动的知名代表组成的国际工人代表团于2月18日抵达广州。这些国家的革命劳工运动由以下人士代表：英国全国少数派运动（National Minority Movement）名誉主席汤姆·曼（Tom Mann）；法国众议院共产党议员雅克·多里奥（Jaques Doriot），他以在摩洛哥、叙利亚和中国无情打击法国帝国主义而闻名；以及厄尔·鲍德纳（Earl Browder），美国工会教育联盟（Trade Union Educational League）执行委员，该组织一直与美国和加拿大的国民党组织开展联合宣传，反对帝国主义并支持中国解放事业。

访问目的

国际工人代表团的目标和宗旨如下：
1. 代表国际无产阶级，向中国国民政府和国民党致以问候，表达同情与团结。
2. 研究中国局势，深入了解中国人民在反对世界帝国主义的伟大斗争中所面临的问题、目标、愿望及需要克服的障碍。
3. 在世界革命劳工运动与中国革命解放运动之间建立联系和持久的战斗联盟。
4. 鼓舞中国人民进行英勇斗争，并尽一切可能为中国革命事业提供道义和物质援助。
5. 利用代表团在中国收集的所有知识和信息，旨在动员国际劳工运动援助革命的中国，防止帝国主义列强实施其掠夺计划。

拜访政府与党部

2月19日，国际工人代表团首先拜访了广东省政府和国民党党部。代表团受到民政厅长陈树人先生的热情接待。代表团向陈树人先生转交了代表们发给国民革命军总司令蒋介石元帅的问候电报。

同日下午，国际工人代表团参观了工会总部以及以下劳工组织：中华全国总工会、香港罢工委员会、广州工人代表大会和香港总工会。这些组织的代表与代表团在总部举行了联席会议，国际工人代表团全体成员均在会上发言。中国劳工代表最热烈地接待了代表团，当向他们解释代表团的目标和宗旨时，他们以极大的热情作出了回应。中华全国总工会主席苏兆征以该组织120万成员的名义（随着国民革命军的推进，这一数字还在不断增加）向代表团致意。他说，国际工人代表团的访问和工作将为中国人民在反对帝国主义和军阀主义的斗争中注入新的能量和勇气。他呼吁国际无产阶级的世界团结，并与世界被压迫人民结盟。他说，有了如此强大的联盟，胜利属于我们。没有什么能阻挡我们。

汤姆·曼的战斗演说

汤姆·曼以英国革命无产阶级的名义发言，表达了英国工人阶级对英国帝国主义在中国残暴掠夺行径的愤慨。他说，与其他列强相比，英国帝国主义海盗在历史上写下了更多压迫数亿殖民地人民的血腥篇章。他指出，中国反对帝国主义的英勇斗争将唤醒印度、南非和埃及的数亿民众。在中国打击英国帝国主义的每一次行动，不仅是中国人民的胜利，也是伦敦、格拉斯哥和曼彻斯特工人的胜利。每当英国强盗在中国失去一个所谓的租界时，英国的革命工人都为之欢欣鼓舞，因为这意味着对他们的敌人——正是同一个敌人——的又一次打击。汤姆·曼呼吁中国人民继续战斗直至取得最终胜利，并将英国帝国主义永远逐出中国。

警惕美帝国主义

美国代表厄尔·白劳德以美国革命工人和工会教育联盟的名义发言，警告中国人民警惕美帝国主义。在美国目前展示的友好面具背后，隐藏着中国人民和中国革命最危险、最狡猾的敌人。美帝国主义之所以假装对中国人民友好，仅仅是因为它认为目前这样做有利可图。但是，就在不久前，当美国派遣士兵和战舰前往尼加拉瓜并实际上在中美洲进行军事干涉时，美帝国主义的真面目便暴露无遗。要提防像美国这样的伪朋友。一旦有机会，她就会做与英国完全相同的事情，甚至可能以更危险的方式行事。在与英国帝国主义者斗争的同时，要密切关注美帝国主义。演讲者随后指出，美国的国民党分部与工会教育联盟之间的密切合作。现在比以往任何时候都更加需要尽最大努力动员美国工人反对美帝国主义，并支持中国人民的历史性解放斗争。

法国帝国主义

雅克·多里奥以法国革命无产阶级的名义发言，揭露了法国对华政策的真实本质。由于害怕国内的革命运动以及日益高涨的中国解放运动如雪崩般袭来，法国帝国主义者目前被迫保持低调。他们退居英国干涉行动的背后，并非出于对中国人民的爱，而仅仅是出于恐惧。但法国帝国主义在华政策的真实目标早在前段时间就被一名法国记者揭露，该记者写道，必须镇压中国的民族革命运动，以便法国人能够占领广东、广西和云南这三个南方省份。这就是法国帝国主义的胃口。就在两周前，法国报刊还建议英国帝国主义采用其他方法来对抗中国国民革命政府，即资助张作霖和其他反动军阀。多里奥指出了法国帝国主义在叙利亚和摩洛哥的政策，以及中国反帝斗争的胜利对其他受压迫

下一位发言者是共产国际代表纳特·罗伊。他代表共产国际组织中数百万革命者，向中国国民政府、国民党及中国人民革命军队致意。

他说，共产国际是唯一代表被压迫阶级和被压迫民族利益的世界性组织，因此它是帝国主义最强大的敌人。国际工人代表团访华证明，共产国际关于联合帝国主义国家的无产阶级与殖民地的被压迫民族共同反对帝国主义的纲领正在得到实现。我们生活在一个革命时期，巨大的力量正在发挥作用，以终结剥削和压迫制度，并在旧世界的废墟上建立一个新世界。这些社会力量就是先进资本主义国家的无产阶级和殖民地的被压迫民族。殖民地人民的反抗如野火般蔓延至世界各个角落，而在中国表现得最为激烈。正是在中国，帝国主义遭受了最大的失败。因此，帝国主义的所有力量都集中起来企图扼杀中国的民族解放运动。但是，目前控制着半个中国的国民政府的地位由两个因素所保障。全体中国人民坚定地站在国民党和国民革命政府一边。另一方面，世界工人阶级决心反对针对中国革命的一切图谋。鉴于这种情况，中国革命的胜利——这一已经赢得一半的胜利——是必然的。共产国际决心动员全世界的无产阶级力量，使在革命的人民民族主义政党领导下的中国革命能够克服面前的一切障碍，从胜利走向胜利，直到中国完全摆脱帝国主义统治，直到本土反动势力和军阀主义被彻底粉碎，直到国家在人民的革命民主政府领导下实现统一，直到一个自由的新中国诞生。

在国际工人代表团成员发言之后，各工会、农民、妇女和学生组织的代表也发表了讲话。
